title: Wonderful!!
text: Wonderful!!. This dresser came packaged beyond well and was fully assembled (minus the legs) which made the process of placing it easier. The piece itself is gorgeous and looks exactly as advertised. The quality is great, if you take care of it, it can last a lifetime! The drawers are very deep and the top, smaller ones are lined with velvet. I actually had leftover room in the drawers when I put my stuff into it. There was 0 damage to the item upon receipt! My TV is a 32” and as you can see there’s lots of room to accommodate a larger TV than that. The colors/tones of this line are perfect for any theme/decor you chose to go with it. I highly recommend!!

product_metadata.title: Signature Design By Ashley Realyn French Country Youth 6 Drawer Dresser, Chipped White & Brown
